questions.text: Describe a family celebration that you enjoyed.
questions.say: Thank you. Now, in Part 2, I'm going to give you a topic, and I'd like you to talk about it for one to two minutes. Before you talk, you'll have one minute to think about what you're going to say. You can make some notes if you wish. Here is your topic. Describe a family celebration that you enjoyed. You should say: what the celebration was; when and where it took place; who was there; and explain why you enjoyed it.

questions.text: Do you have celebrations like this often in your family?
questions.say: Thank you. Do you have celebrations like this often in your family?

questions.text: What are the most important celebrations in your country?
questions.say: Thank you. We've been talking about a family celebration you enjoyed, and I'd like to discuss with you some more general questions related to this. Let's consider first of all celebrations. What are the most important celebrations in your country?

questions.text: Why do people spend a lot of money on celebrations such as weddings?

questions.text: Have celebrations in your country changed over the last twenty years?
questions.say: Have celebrations in your country changed over the last twenty years?

questions.text: Why is it important for families to have traditions?

questions.text: Are young people as interested in family traditions as older people?
